name: The Multiverse
summary: An infinite set of parallel universes. It opened up in the MCU after He Who Remains was killed.

name: Incursions
summary: Two universes collide and one destroys the other.
citation: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

name: Anchor beings
summary: A person whose existence holds a universe together. When they die, that universe begins to end.

name: Earth-828
summary: The Fantastic Four's home universe, separate from the main MCU's Earth-616.
